name: ley-memory
description: Private, local project memory and cited continuity for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Local project memory that survives Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Ley Memory connects Codex to a user-owned local vault through MCP and lifecycle hooks. It loads bounded cited context, captures stable turn summaries, and keeps learning approval under user control.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Ley to resume this project's durable local context before continuing.
